entities.name: Virot Maglan

entities.name: Karona

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: Event in which Kuberr received powers.

events.summary: In the Fall of the Primevals Kuberr imprisons Crosis in a tar pit catacomb and receives his powers.
events.quote: Kuberr imprisoned the black Primeval Crosis the Purger in a tar pit catacomb in Urborg and received his powers

events.summary: Kuberr helps kill the green and white numena, leaving Lowallyn, Averru and himself.
events.quote: Kuberr participated in killing the green and the white numena

events.summary: Kuberr contacts Virot Maglan in a dream, granting death power for worship, seeding the Cabal.
events.quote: Kuberr contacted Virot Maglan in a dream and granted him the power of death in return for worship

events.summary: Kuberr is killed, suffocating trapped in stone encased by Karona.
events.quote: Kuberr was left trapped inside too long and suffocated

relations.quote: Karona tried to kill them all by encasing them in a solid block of stone
Kuberr imprisoned the black Primeval Crosis the Purger
They claimed dominion over the plane for 1,000 years
